#### 🇬🇧 English
Welcome to the comeback of the legendary Frankfurt Cube Days! 
Feel free to register, compete, visit and ask questions!
Contact: frankfurt.cubing@gmail.com
Have fun!

Kontakt: frankfurt.cubing@gmail.com
Viel Spaß!
